codon_counts.name: Number of sense codons per amino acid (standard genetic code)
codon_counts.reference: Saravanan V. & Gautham N. (2015). Harnessing computational biology for exact linear B-cell epitope prediction: a novel amino acid composition-based feature descriptor. OMICS, 19(10), 648-658.
codon_counts.source_note: Standard genetic code (NCBI translation table 1), 61 sense codons, as used for the DDE theoretical mean; 2026-10-12.

atomic_formulas.name: Molecular formulas of the free amino acids
atomic_formulas.reference: Pande A. et al. (2023). Computing wide range of protein/peptide features from their sequence and structure. J Comput Biol, 30(2), 204-222.
atomic_formulas.source_note: Standard free amino-acid formulas; cross-checked against Pfeature's Standalone/Data/atom.csv. Pfeature sums free amino-acid formulas without removing water (protpy's default convention). Its table over-counts H by one for W (C11H13N2O2) and Y (C9H12NO3); the correct formulas C11H12N2O2 and C9H11NO3 are used here, so W/Y-containing sequences differ slightly from Pfeature output. Transcribed 2026-10-12.
